# Method

We took water samples at four sites along the river, once a week for six weeks.
Each sample went to the laboratory on the same day.

| Site | Distance (km) | Samples |
|------|--------------:|--------:|
| Weir | 0.0 | 6 |
| Mill | 2.4 | 6 |
| Ford | 5.1 | 6 |
| Mouth | 9.8 | 6 |

: Sampling sites.

```python
import polars as pl

samples = pl.read_csv("samples.csv")
samples.group_by("site").agg(pl.col("nitrate").mean())
```

# Results

Nitrate levels went up from the weir to the mouth, and the change was largest after the mill.
The ford had the most variation between weeks.

| Site | Mean nitrate (mg/L) |
|------|--------------------:|
| Weir | 1.8 |
| Mill | 2.9 |
| Ford | 3.1 |
| Mouth | 3.4 |

: Mean nitrate by site.

```python
samples.filter(pl.col("site") == "Ford").select("week", "nitrate")
```
